units: C$ billion in a fixed 2026-price benchmark; shares and rates are fractions
limits: Not an equilibrium or household model
Capital rates are average combined federal corporate and owner charges after tax credits on one base, before collection losses; they are not statutory rates
Capital income base excludes depreciation and untaxable or foreign-allocated amounts but is before federal and provincial tax
Provincial taxes and costs must be costed separately; no share of their receipts is assigned to Ottawa
Consumption is tax-exclusive; collection factor is before an explicit selected20bn retainedGSTcredit allowance and separate new rebates; no measured compliance rate or official relief cost is implied
Rebates are selected allowances, not proof of unchanged buying power
Net worth includes housing and pension claims; scale figures are not added to package yields
GDP multiples are scenarios for income valued at fixed prices, not AI or tax forecasts
